pages.text: You can explore the world and dodge attacks quickly and easily with the help of rollovers by tapping $(9)$(k:elenaidodge2.dodge)$(). Above the hunger indicator is the endurance indicator. By rolling over, the indicator is gradually being spent,
but after stopping rolling, it will begin to replenish.
The weight of your armor directly affects the scale
pages.title: Endurance

pages.text: endurance.$(br2)The heavier the armor, the less you can roll. But by enchanting the armor to «Lightweight», you will be able to make more rolls.
